verdict.rationale: Galileo offers background alerting on logs (e.g., cost spikes, hallucination rates) and a feedback loop that 'automatically improves metrics,' which are thin forms of autonomous background automation, but there's no evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow scheduler or agent-runner that executes tasks autonomously. missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger-action automation builder, evidence of autonomous task execution beyond alerting, independent confirmation of background automation reliability.
